title: Find Minimum
description: Write a function that finds and returns the smallest number in a vector. For example, given {3, 7, 2, 9, 1} the function should return 1.
instructions: Complete the find_minimum function so it returns the smallest number in the vector.
hints: Think about how you would find the smallest number by going through the list one by one.
Start by assuming the first element is the minimum, then update it if you find something smaller.
Use an if statement inside your loop to check if the current number is less than your current minimum.
